description: This file contains platform-specific functions for device initialization, upgrade procedures, and configuration copying in the OpenWrt/LEDE embedded Linux project. It handles different device boards based on their names and performs appropriate actions such as image checks, upgrades, and configuration copies.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image based on the board name, delegating to specific image check functions depending on the device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a device-specific upgrade operation based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the device-specific configuration based on the board name.
